# caltopo-random: the owner's styled CalTopo test map

A small map the owner drew in CalTopo on 2026-10-22 to exercise styling, exported unedited as
GeoJSON (`onx-test-random.json`), GPX and KML. No folders.

| Item | CalTopo styling |
|---|---|
| blerg (marker) | `campfire`, `#3ef000`, two-paragraph note |
| Hiker (marker) | `hiking`, `#009aff` |
| section 1 (line) | `#ff0000`, width 2, solid, trailing space in the GeoJSON title |
| straight line (line) | `#00cd00`, width 6, opacity 0.1, **arrow** pattern |
| Chaos line (line) | `#000000`, width 4, **long-dash** pattern |
| Fire zone (area) | `#0090ff`, width 4, opacity 0.2, fill opacity 0 |

What it settled (see `PARITY.md`):

- CalTopo KML icon links for built-in symbols are `cfg=<symbol>,<RRGGBB>#1.0`.
- CalTopo GPX writes a Garmin `DisplayColor` only for an exact Garmin colour (`#000000` →
  `Black`); `#ff0000` (lower case) and `#00cd00` get none.
- CalTopo GPX writes an area as a closed `<trk>`.
- Pattern values: long dash `M0 -3 L0 3,,12,F` (→ onX `dash`), arrows
  `M-6 8L0 -8M6 8L0 -8M0 0L-6 8M0 0L6 8,20,40,T` (→ `solid`: onX has no arrows).

`cairn_output/from_<format>/` and `PARITY.md` are generated by
`uv run python scripts/caltopo_random_parity.py`; `tests/test_caltopo_random_parity.py` fails on drift.
